hooks.name: aide-knowledge-drift
hooks.description: Identify knowledge artifacts that may have drifted after relevant changes.

action.prompt: Run `uv run --project .aide/full/hook --offline --frozen aide-hook aide-knowledge-drift`. If `has_relevant_change` is false, stop. Otherwise inspect only the reported changed artifacts and candidate knowledge targets. Propose the narrowest HLD, LLD, folder SPECS.md, knowledge-plane descriptor, runbook, API collection, or secondary OpenWiki updates needed. Do not edit or publish them in this hook, do not write to Graphiti directly, and clearly state that a human review is required.
